title: mandevilla coccinea
intro: Mandevilla coccinea, commonly known as the "Red Mandevilla" or "Rock Trumpet", is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is native to South America and is known for its vibrant red or pink trumpet-shaped flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and treat wounds. The bioactive constituents of Mandevilla coccinea include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesia, anti-hypertension, and anti-cancer activities.
